source: Owner supplied QR and wallet destination on 2026-10-04; bank transfer deferred.

methods.instructions: Scan the attached QR code, transfer the amount in the currency shown on your order, then upload your transfer receipt. Your package activates after an administrator verifies the transfer and confirms the payment.
